Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: Chestnut
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 04/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 632 as introduced could increase the supervision obligations of the Board of Pardons and Paroles by an undetermined amount, dependent on the number of inmates serving consecutive sentences that are granted parole and released from the custody of the Department of Corrections pursuant to this bill.
In addition, this could decrease the obligations of the Department of Corrections by an undetermined amount, dependent on the number of inmates serving consecutive sentences that are granted parole and released to the supervision of the Board of Pardons and Paroles pursuant to this bill.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary
